name: near_drone_height_unknown
description: Missing drone alt_geo (null or the -1000 marker) or missing aircraft alt_geom: the NEAR warning is raised with HEIGHT UNKNOWN; alt_baro is never compared with a drone.
worked_example: D9A03 has no alt_geo (null): UAL123 500 m away (300 E, 400 N) -> vert unknown, not passed -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9A03, HEIGHT UNKNOWN.
N911HC reports only altb_ft 1000 (304.8 m pressure altitude); DJI-1's alt_geo 120 is never compared with it -> vert unknown -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE DJI-1, HEIGHT UNKNOWN (id <= 8 chars is used whole).
Drone D9B77 sends the ODID 'unknown' marker -1000 -> unknown -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE D9B77, HEIGHT UNKNOWN; the callsign-less aircraft is keyed by hex e5f6a7.
MRK4 sends altg_m -1000 (the same marker, on the aircraft side): 600 m S of DJI-1 -> TRAFFIC NEAR DRONE DJI-1, HEIGHT UNKNOWN.
Resolution with the height unknown: descend and land, e.g. 'GIVE WAY: DESCEND AND LAND D9A03; AIRCRAFT HEIGHT UNKNOWN, 500 M NE'.

hand_checks.why: 600 m S; altg_m -1000 is the unknown marker

expect.summary: conflict watch on, 4 ADS-B conflicts, data 2 s old
